Adds red and yellow player skins to Settings → DRAGON, alongside green and blue. Selection cycles forward/reverse, updates the preview, and persists per profile. The selected skin appears in gameplay and the life icon, including co-op player one; player two stays blue. Existing version-1 profiles keep their settings and statistics.

Both variants preserve all 19 original animation frames through exact palette aliases, without duplicate PNGs or atlas textures. An overlap regression also exposed an inherited static-compositor color-space bug: composed colors now reach the material before sRGB decoding, instead of being brightened as a later renderer tint. Original art and Go fixtures are untouched.

Local macOS arm64 V8/Metal validation: `harness:verify-full` passed (116 T0, 20 T1, seven independent replay verifications, cold live viewport, typecheck/validate/cook/600-step smoke, provenance guards). The animation sheet has 59,584 exact pixel comparisons with zero mismatches. GPU tests cover flips, clipping, preview/icon sizes and translucent overlap; real Settings button tests cover solo/co-op and save/reload behavior. Existing goldens remain unchanged; 11 captures were added.

All-tier pipeline coverage runs 643 steps/215 frames per tier and checks red/yellow labels plus actual body-color pixels. Peak draws remain 11/9/9 against the existing limit of 14, with no added atlas residency. Hermes, physical OS-input/display and device-performance checks remain untested; existing tile-12 and built-in Standard pipeline warnings remain. No engine changes or computer-use access. Details: `docs/dragon-skins.md` and `docs/rendering.md`.
